categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Modifies wallet transaction fee-bumping logic and RPC in src/wallet/feebumper.cpp, src/wallet/feebumper.h, and src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents bumpfee from silently dropping outputs like OP_RETURN and redirecting change when an invalid original_change_index is specified, while refactoring CreateRateBumpTransaction to unblock #35302. Commit d03bccefa1 notes that previously '[s]uch an output, like an OP_RETURN, was silently dropped from the bumped transaction and change sent to a new address.'
